name: COCO Captions
description: The COCO Captions dataset provides human-written natural-language descriptions for images from the Microsoft COCO dataset, supporting image captioning and vision-language research. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Chen, X., Fang, H., Lin, T.-Y., Vedantam, R., Gupta, S., Dollar, P., & Zitnick, C. L. (2015). Microsoft COCO Captions: Data Collection and Evaluation Server. arXiv:1504.00325. https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.00325
